decodeLatency.definition: per decoded frame: performance.now() at the decoder output callback minus the moment its EncodedVideoChunk was handed to decode(). throughput.definition: per layer, the interval between consecutive decoder output callbacks — the layer's own decode throughput, independent of queue depth.

audio.driftDefinition: audioContext.currentTime advance minus wall-clock advance at the end of the window. Audio is on its own thread; a render loop that falls behind must not move this number.
